newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-St George says bond issue possible.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-St George says bond issue possible.

text.p: St George Bank Ltd said on Tuesday it could soon announce a bond issue but would not comment specifically on a newspaper report that it planned to raise US$500 million in a five-year issue.

"We are quite active in the wholesale markets on a regular basis so it is quite possible that something could be announced in the near future," St George chief financial officer Steve McKerihan told Reuters.
The Australian Financial Review newspaper said on Tuesday that St George was set to raise US$500 million with a five-year maturity, led by BZW and Union Bank of Switzerland.
The newspaper also said St George executives were understood to be in Europe on a fund-raising roadshow due to end early next month.
Asked if bank executives were on a roadshow, he said: "Not right as of today but there will be people travelling shortly."
"I am not in a position to announce anything specific at this stage but it is quite possible," he said of the newspaper article.
The Sydney based regional bank, which specialises in home loans, has been upgraded by Moody's Investors Service and Standard and Poor's since it acquired Advance Bank last month.
St George's long-term rating was upgraded by Moody's to A3 from Baa1 on February 8, while S&P raised its long-term rating to A from A minus on January 29.
